_comment: Single source of truth for headline-theorem statuses. scripts/ledger.sh VALIDATES every entry: a status of proven or proven_fragment requires (a) no sorry in the file, (b) the declared witness module to build, (c) the axiom snapshot to match. Docs (README/RELEASES/paper/draft-ietf) may not claim more than this file says — scripts/check-claims.sh enforces. Status vocabulary: proven | proven_fragment | stated | open | vacuous.

T1_decidability.fragment: propositional (PropDeriv: 22 constructors, additive contexts, no linear splitting)
open: full-calculus decidability (linear context splitting, modal/temporal/IFC constructors)
complexity bound O(|M| · log |Γ|) — unproven in any form, for any fragment

T2_correspondence.proven_content: t2_propositional_correspondence — axiom-free symbolic characterization: crypto typing ⇔ logical typing ∧ allSigsVerify. Definitional-refinement strength (Aura 2008 class); NOT a cryptographic soundness theorem.
T2_correspondence.history: the former axiom Sig_EUF_CMA_propositional was refutable in-system (theory proved False); deleted 2026-07, refutation machine-checked in the witness
open: attacker-based T2: verifier acceptance ⇒ derivation from uncompromised principals, vs explicit Dolev-Yao adversary with key compromise
wire-encoding injectivity for the real CBOR codec inside the theorem

T3_noninterference.note: t3_non_interference is one-run reflexivity with the typing derivation discarded; it carries no information-flow content and holds for ill-typed terms. Not non-interference.
open: two-run non-interference: logical relation over pairs of derivations differing in high-labeled hypotheses, with a fundamental lemma by induction on the derivation

T4_obligation.note: t4_no_new_obligation is a real induction over a VACUOUS statement: pendingObligations is provably the constant [] (see pendingObligations_eq_nil — no Term constructor carries an Obligation).
open: obligation-carrying term constructor + discharge redex in Reduce.lean
multiset accounting: obligations(M') = obligations(M) − discharged + introduced
label-ledger fusion: discharging an obligation cannot leak below its label

protocol_correspondence.proven_content: l2_5_trace_lifting — restricted to the singleton [Says P φ] trace shape (the only shape liftToDeriv covers).
open: total liftToDeriv over all Tamarin-model trace shapes with TraceWellFormed load-bearing
L2.3 wire round-trip + injectivity about the real CBOR encoder (former identity-serializer witness deleted 2026-07)

substitution_lemma.proven_content: syntactic shift/subst helper lemmas; typed substitution preservation for PropDeriv lives in DLC/Decidability.lean
open: substitution composition over the full 21-constructor Term
substitution preservation for the full Deriv judgment (linear cases)

theorems: propositional subject reduction via preservation lemmas
open: subject reduction for the full Deriv judgment
